VOID
!

COLOR * #000000
COLOR o #ff7700

CHARMAP c !

HIDDEN_LINE_CHAR %

BIND d walk "move east" e breathe "breathe"

o*---c!
_______
O2:...|
%:--->%

DESCRIPTION HUD fixture: hidden register rows, display maps, and the
DESCRIPTION oxygen counter idioms (negative-step and multi-seed LET_REPEAT).

CMD walk
 TRY_ALL
  ATOMIC
   MATCH1
    FOR s -!
     *s -*

   CALL consume_oxygen

CMD breathe
 ATOMIC
  ROTATE
   *o

  CALL refill_oxygen

CMD consume_oxygen
 FOR d -|
  LET_REPEAT 3 0 -1 r .
   O2:r.d O2:r-d

  O2:.d O2:-d die

CMD die
 * -

CMD refill_oxygen
 LET_REPEAT 1 3 1 r ? s .
  O2:r| O2:s|
